context: Tests whether the agent notices that the governance in an otherwise sound draft is heavier than a 30-person team needs.

checklist.name: Flags the process as too heavy
checklist.description: response.md says the review board, sign-offs, written justifications, documentation gates or exception votes are more process than a team of about 30 needs.

checklist.name: Ties it to team size
checklist.description: response.md connects the concern to the team's headcount, for example by saying this is what a much larger company would run, or that it is overhead at this size.

checklist.name: Points to a lighter alternative
checklist.description: response.md suggests replacing the formal flow with something lighter, such as judgment by the owners, a short conversation, or a single reviewer, or asks the author what they would do without the Board.

checklist.name: Does not rewrite the draft
checklist.description: response.md does not contain a full rewritten strategy, and draft.md is unchanged.

checklist.name: Recognizes what works
checklist.description: response.md acknowledges something sound in the draft, such as the specific opening or the explicit nos, rather than rejecting all of it.
